This is such a treat for my skin. It offers hydration without that heavy feel, and it's packed with ingredients like niacinamide and peptides, both important in my routine. Niacinamide is known for smoothing skin texture, brightening, and minimizing pores. The peptides are great for a little boost in elasticity and helps skin stay resilient, which I'm never opposed to. It also has hyaluronic acid and polyglutamic acid, a duo I love because it locks in hydration. I want to note that it's made without oils and is water based, which is a huge bonus if you're like me and tend to get that midday shine. The texture is light but still feels luxurious. It also layers really well under makeup without pilling. This cream is quite spendy, you're looking at about $30 for the travel size. Although I like this cream and its ingredients, there are other moisturizers out there that create the same result but at a more affordable price. If you have some extra money to spend and want to splurge on a luxurious cream, I'd say go for it. In my opinion it's lovely, but not a "must have".

avis.titre: A Week with Charlotte's Magic Water Cream: A Personal Transf
avis.texte: I've been using Charlotte's Magic Water Cream for a week now, and it has truly transformed my skincare routine. This lightweight, gel-based moisturizer is perfect for my combination skin. It hydrates deeply without making my skin oily, creating a silky smooth base for my makeup. From the first application, my skin felt refreshed and incredibly soft. The cream absorbs quickly, leaving no greasy residue, which is a huge plus for me. Over the week, I've noticed a significant improvement in my skin's texture and tone. My pores appear smaller, and my skin looks more radiant and even. The best part? It keeps my skin hydrated all day long, even in the tricky areas like my T-zone. This cream has become an essential part of my daily routine, and I can't imagine my skincare regimen without it. Highly recommend giving it a try if you're looking for a boost in hydration and a smoother complexion!

avis.titre: A High Quality Moisturizer For Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: Okay, so I've been using this new Charlotte Tilbury moisturizer called Magic Water Cream, and it's the real deal. I have dry, sensitive skin, and this stuff is a lifesaver. At first, I was like, "No way, this is too light," but it's super hydrating. It's like a drink of water for my skin, but without the feeling of greasy residue. I use it with the Magic Serum Crystal Elixir, and my skin feels like a dream. My redness is way down, and my skin texture is smoother than ever. Plus, it doesn't make my T-zone oily, which is a huge win. I've tried a ton of moisturizers, but this one is the best. It's gentle enough for sensitive skin, but it still provides the hydration my skin needs. And the best part? It doesn't have a strong fragrance, which can be irritating for those of us with sensitive skin. One thing I really appreciate about Magic Water Cream is that it helps my makeup apply more smoothly. My foundation looks flawless, and my pores appear smaller. I used to struggle with redness and uneven skin tone, but this moisturizer has made a significant difference. The packaging is also a plus. The glass jar is elegant and feels luxurious, and the lid is easy to twist off and on. While it might not be the most eco-friendly option, it's a small price to pay for such a great product. I've been using Magic Water Cream for a few weeks now, and I've already noticed a noticeable improvement in my skin. My complexion is brighter, my skin is less reactive, and my overall skin health has impr

avis.titre: Slightly misleading and doesn't layer well
avis.texte: Was excited to try this because I LOVE water and gel moisturizers when they work as promised. Unfortunately when I opened the jar this didn't really look like a water cream and is a thicker consistency that looks only slightly thinner than the OG Magic Cream, so that disappointed me but I still tried it in a few ways. I layer a few serums in my skincare routine and during the day I typically can't use more than a water cream otherwise my face is left too oily/dewy. I used this after the Magic Serum and a niacinimide and ceramide serum and typically my skin has a bit of a glow but this left it incredibly shiny/oily looking, almost like the cream has some mica in it. I had to powder my face even after using my mattifying SPF which typically isn't something I need to do. I did try this cream on its own and my skin did absorb it better, but it took a solid 30 minutes. I found it worked great under makeup as a first step before primer and my foundation looked great! But for daily skincare needs this doesn't have enough benefits for me to use with nothing else, so I can't really justify the price or plan to purchase this in the future. If you have drier skin this may be helpful for you though.

avis.titre: Slight oiliness at first that disappears into hydrated skin
avis.texte: I received this travel size Water cream complimentary in exchange for my honest review. First of all, for a travel size container, this is super cute! The packaging is really v pretty and the jar is sturdy and fits perfectly for travel. It is a lightweight gel cream that goes on smooth and doesn't feel oily on my face. The ingredients didn't cause any reaction, which is always a good thing! This is my first time trying Charlotte Tilbury Skin Care so I was quite intrigued by a water cream. I didn't notice any kind of smell to it at all, and it is very lightweight and dries quickly, leaving your skin feeling soft and hydrated while having a smooth texture . It did leave my skin feeling slightly oily at first, but that feeling faded throughout the day, but the hydrated feeling remained. I will definitely consider more Charlotte Tillbury products after trying this out!
